title: Are AI models actually creative? 🤔
author: uskyeeeee
selftext:
Are AI models actually creative? 🤔

Made a site where GPT-4, Claude & Gemini do daily GameJams with just ONE word. You judge the winner.

RT if you're curious to see what they come up with 👀

Your votes = the new creativity benchmark.

I run daily AI GameJam tests with randomly generated themes. Here's what I've observed:

Claude: Rock-solid consistency, zero creativity. Stays in its comfort zone—turns every theme into a Binding-of-Isaac clone.

Gemini: Nice art, occasionally inspired, but lazy as hell. Barebones implementations, often broken.

GPT: Most creative, but feels forced. Over-engineers complex rules and uses the same UI template every time (overfine-tuned to death).

Grok: Actually impressive, but its games feel like 2023-era AI. Disqualified from my GameJam for now—waiting for v2.

Open-source (GLM/MiniMax): Stable and predictable, yet never creative. Probably distilled Claude too aggressively.

comments.author: Hanfkeks_
comments.body: I honestly doubt that you can get a game working with just one prompt and one word. What's your stack? Engine? Development environment? etc.
